name: Within the Beckoning Deep
source:
The Siren's Cove is cursed. Anything that washes on its shores, be it as simple as a bit of sea glass, or tempting as sparkling gemstones, should go untouched. Those that dare take anything will one day be taken by the sea in turn.

Cordelia has spent many years guarding the cove from trespassers alongside her father, but one fateful night everything changes. Will she dare to face the evil that lurks in the deep?

[From [url=https://wispna.itch.io/within-the-beckoning-deep]itch.io[/url]]
